name: OHLC Stochastic
summary: This EA implements a Stochastic oscillator-based mean reversion strategy, generating buy signals when the Stochastic enters oversold territory and sell signals when it reaches overbought zones. It uses OHLC price data to compute the Stochastic values and executes trades automatically based on crossover signals within the oscillator. The strategy targets reversal points in the market where price is expected to revert to its mean.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于随机振荡器的均值回归策略，当随机指标进入超卖区域时产生买入信号，进入超买区域时产生卖出信号。它使用OHLC价格数据计算随机指标值，并根据振荡器内的交叉信号自动执行交易。策略针对市场中价格预期回归均值时的反转点。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于随机振荡器（Stochastic Oscillator）的均值回归策略，核心概念是利用%K和%D线的交叉以及超买超卖区域来判断价格反转时机。入场条件为：当%K线从超卖区（通常低于20）上穿%D线时买入，当%K线从超买区（通常高于80）下穿%D线时卖出。出场条件依赖于反向交叉信号或预设的止盈止损水平，但具体实现取决于参数配置中的止损和止盈设置。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金比例的仓位计算方式，允许用户通过参数进行调整。资金管理方面，EA可能包含最大持仓限制和账户权益保护机制，但需注意其止损设置是否充分。整体策略逻辑清晰，适合震荡行情，但在强趋势市场中可能面临连续亏损的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements a mean reversion strategy based on the Stochastic Oscillator, with the core concept of using %K and %D line crossovers combined with overbought/oversold zones to identify price reversal opportunities. Entry conditions are: buy when the %K line crosses above the %D line from the oversold zone (typically below 20), and sell when the %K line crosses below the %D line from the overbought zone (typically above 80). Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals or preset take-profit and stop-loss levels, depending on the parameter configuration. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size or an equity-proportional calculation method, with users able to adjust via input parameters. Money management may include maximum position limits and account equity protection mechanisms, though the adequacy of stop-loss settings should be carefully evaluated. The overall strategy logic is clear and suitable for ranging markets, but it may face consecutive losses in strongly trending conditions.
pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于经典的随机振荡器指标，易于理解和验证
利用超买超卖区域入场，在震荡行情中具有较高的胜率
参数可调性强，用户可以根据不同品种和周期优化参数组合
OHLC数据驱动，计算方式透明可靠
均值回归逻辑在盘整市场中表现优异，风险收益比可控
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on the classic Stochastic oscillator, easy to understand and verify
High win rate in ranging markets by entering at overbought/oversold zones
Highly configurable parameters allowing optimization across different instruments and timeframes
OHLC data-driven with transparent and reliable calculation methodology
Mean reversion logic performs well in consolidation markets with controllable risk-reward ratio
cons: 在强趋势行情中容易产生连续虚假信号，导致反复亏损
默认止损和止盈可能为零，缺乏有效的风险保护机制
缺少趋势过滤器，无法区分震荡市和趋势市，可能在趋势中逆势交易
没有新增K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上反复开仓
缺乏点差过滤，在高点差环境下入场成本过高影响盈利
cons_en: Prone to consecutive false signals in strongly trending markets, leading to repeated losses
Default stop-loss and take-profit may be zero, lacking effective risk protection mechanisms
No trend filter to distinguish between ranging and trending markets, risking counter-trend entries
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar
Lacks spread filter, resulting in high entry costs that erode profitability in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或更高周期均线），避免在强趋势中逆势交易
增加新增K线检查和持仓检查机制，防止重复开仓和过度交易
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or higher timeframe moving average) to avoid counter-trend trades in strong trends
Add new bar check and position check mechanisms to prevent duplicate entries and overtrading

risk_points: 止损和止盈默认可能为零，存在无限亏损风险
缺乏趋势过滤器，在趋势行情中逆势交易风险较高
缺少点差过滤和滑点保护机制
risk_points_en: Stop-loss and take-profit defaults may be zero, creating unlimited loss risk
Lack of trend filter increases risk of counter-trend trades in trending markets
No spread filter or slippage protection mechanism
